topics.notes: Linear, quadratic, absolute-value, rational; solving and modelling. Easy to medium.
Domain/range, linear, quadratic, polynomial, piecewise, transformations, inverse and composition.
Laws of exponents, exponential/log functions and equations.
Ratios, unit circle, identities, trig functions and equations, laws of sines/cosines.
Lines, circles, conics, area/volume, similarity, distance and midpoint.
Vector operations, dot product, matrix operations, determinants, 2x2 systems.
Measures of centre/spread, counting, permutations/combinations, probability rules, distributions (basic).
Intro level: limits, derivative rules, simple applications, basic integrals. Medium to hard.
